On trailing delay embedding (m=2,tau=1), L-inf recurrence eps=0.5*std(window). Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE/MAXDIAGLINE_DIVERGENCE/ratio undefined/non-finite/degenerate or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps.
